page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-24-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 12 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 186 GB of RAM, providing 7.75 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of 1343 GB of NVMe SSD capacity across four local drives. The processor operates at a base speed of 2.3 GHz and includes a 504 MB L3 cache alongside advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX).

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates top-tier single-threaded performance, particularly in data processing tasks. Single-threaded gzip compression reached 36.68 GB/sec, and bzip3 decompression achieved 15.42 GB/sec, both placing in the top 10% of tested instances. Geekbench single-core and text processing scores also rank in the top 10%. Multi-core performance is strong, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 16159.0 and image processing capabilities in the top 25%. For machine learning workloads, the hardware-assisted AMX instructions support small-model LLM inference, delivering 394.37 tokens/sec for text generation on a 135M parameter model.

While single-core throughput and text processing are highly competitive, multi-threaded decompression and memory bandwidth for large uncached blocks (153.52 GB/sec read and 56.59 GB/sec write) fall into the average tier. This indicates a tradeoff where single-threaded execution and localized cache utilization outperform massive parallel memory transfers. Given the combination of 186 GB of RAM, dedicated CPU allocation, and 1343 GB of local NVMe storage, this server is configured for memory-intensive workloads, local database hosting, text processing pipelines, and small-scale language model inference.
